page.overview:
Who is Hebros?

Hebros was a river-god of Kikonia in eastern Thrake (modern day northern Greece and southern Bulgaria.

The headwaters of the Hebros were on Mount Rhodope in the northern part of Thrake and emptied out into the Aegian Sea near Ainos opposite the island Samothrake.
